description: EVM-007 AC7 (ADR-0018 "Gdzie żyją sekrety"; architect 14): the files of /etc/evia/secrets (0700, files 0600 root) each service receives as a tmpfs copy in /run/evia/secrets/<service>/ (0400, owned by its UID). deploy.sh refuses to start when a file is missing or has another owner or mode. The migrator password reaches migrate only. Installed in the IaC session at /etc/evia/deploy-agent/secrets.manifest.json.
